topic.title: Compulsory Purchase / Land Assembly / Compensation
topic.source_contract: acquiring authority powers, public purpose, scheme justification, land plans, attempts by agreement, resolution, order making, objections, inquiry, confirmation, vesting, compensation and implementation evidence

scope_guards: A land assembly proposal is not treated as a made compulsory purchase order.
A resolution to use powers is not treated as order confirmation.
An order map is not treated as acquired title.
Negotiation by agreement is not treated as completed acquisition.
Confirmation is not treated as vesting or possession.
A compensation estimate is not treated as an agreed or determined award.
Removal of hope value is not assumed without the exact statutory direction.
No score or promotion is written without exact power, order, confirmation, vesting, title and scheme-delivery evidence.
